    {"name": "review_sentence_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.4, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Largely redundant with word count and generic structural metric; still soundly derived from text."},
    {"name": "exclamation_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 0.97, "rationale": "Punctuation intensity is a genuine stylistic facet plausibly linked to sentiment; trivially extractable and values match text."},
    {"name": "question_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.97, "rationale": "Rhetorical questions can mark negative/critical reviews; well grounded (row 1 and 3 questions counted correctly)."},
    {"name": "caps_word_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "All-caps emphasis is a plausible sentiment-linked facet; mostly grounded though 'REAL' title vs content scope makes some counts ambiguous."},
    {"name": "positive_word_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Directly relevant to sentiment facet analysis and gives comparative leverage; lexicon-based so somewhat dependent on word list but readings are reasonable."},
    {"name": "negative_word_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Strong axis for contrasting facets by sentiment; row 3 (clearly negative text) counted 0 negative words shows lexicon limits, but generally sound."},
    {"name": "has_personal_pronoun", "analytical_usefulness": 0.35, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Near-constant (203/47) and generic; adds little discriminating leverage though accurately extracted."},
    {"name": "avg_word_length", "analytical_usefulness": 0.4, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Low-variance stylistic metric with weak link to sentiment facets; correctly computable from text."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.55,
  "source_groundedness": 0.92,
  "rationale": "The added columns are all extractive/computable facets soundly derived from the review text, with no invented facts (values in row samples match the source). For the query about how facets differ by sentiment, the sentiment-lexicon and punctuation columns provide genuine analytical axes, while several structural metrics (sentence count, avg word length, personal pronoun flag) are generic, low-variance, or redundant, dragging holistic usefulness to moderate. Groundedness is high overall; the only soft spots are lexicon-based sentiment counts that occasionally miss clearly negative rows (e.g., row 3), but these are reasonable readings rather than hallucinations."
}
